div.head: Af El. 13
div.ab: Se man þe hys gewealdes man ofslea, swelte se deaþe. Se þe hine þonne neades ofslea oððe ungewylles oððe ungewealdes, swylce hyne God sende swa on his handa, ⁊ he him ne syrwde ymbe, sy he feores wyrþe ⁊ folcrihtere bote, gif he friðstowe gesece. Gyf hwa þonne of geornnesse ⁊ gewealdes ofslea hys þone nyhstan þurh syrwunge, alúc þu hyne fram minum weofode, to ðam þæt he deaþe swelte.

Se mon se ðe his gewealdes monnan ófslea, swelte se deaðe. Se ðe hine þonne nedes ófsloge oððe unwillum oððe ungewealdes, swelce hine God swa sende on his honda, ⁊ he hine ne ymbsyrede, sie he feores wyrðe ⁊ folcryhtre bote, gif he friðstowe gesece. Gif hwa ðonne óf giernesse ⁊ gewealdes ófslea his þone nehstan þurh searwa, aluc ðu hine from minum weofode, to þam þæt he deaðe swelte.

Se man se ðe his gewealdes man ofslea, swelte se deaðe. Se ðe hyne ðonne nydes ofsloge oððe unwillum oððe ungewealdes, swylce hine God swa sende on hys handa, ⁊ he hyne ymbe ne sierede, sy he feores wyrþe ⁊ folcrihtre bote, gif he fryðstowa gesece. Gyf hwa þonne of geornnesse ⁊ gewealdes ofslea his ðone nyehstan ðurh searwa, aluc ðu hine fram minan weofode, to ðam þæt he deaðe swelte.

Qui percusserit hominem uolens occidere, morte moriatur. Qui autem non est insidiatus, sed Deus illum tradidit in manus eius, constituam tibi locum quo fugere debeat. Si quis per industriam occiderit proximum suum et per insidias, ab altari meo auelles eum, ut moriatur.

Se mon se ðe his gewealdes monnan ofslea, swelte se deaðe. Se ðe hine þonne nedes ofsloge oððe unwillum oððe ungewealdes, swelce hine God swa sende on his honda, ⁊ he hine ne ymbsyrede, sie he feores wyrðe ⁊ folcryhtre bote, gif he friðstowe gesece. Gif hwa ðonne of giernesse ⁊ gewealdes ofslea his þone nehstan þurh searwa, aluc ðu hine from minum weofode, to þam þæt he deaðe swelte.

The man who intentionally slays someone – let him die the death. However, he who slew him out of necessity or unwillingly or accidentally, as God sent to his hands, and he did not lie in wait [for his victim]: let him be worthy of life and of the remedy permitted by folk-law, if he should seek a place of refuge. But if someone with deliberation and intent slays his neighbor through guile, take him away from my altar, that he may die the death.

Der Mensch, welcher aus eigener Macht einen Menschen erschlägt, der sterbe Todes. Wer ihn aber aus Noth erschlagen hat oder unfreiwillig oder ohne dafür zu können, wie Gott ihn so in seine Hände lieferte, und [wenn] er ihn nicht umlauert hat, so sei er des Lebens und volksrechtlicher Busse würdig, wenn er eine Schutzstätte findet. Wenn jemand dagegen aus Absicht und mit Willen seinen Nächsten durch Nachstellungen tödtet, so reisse du ihn fort von meinem Altare, auf dass er Todes sterbe.

The person who slays a person of his own will, let him die the death. But whoever slew him out of necessity, or unwillingly, or without being able to help it, as God so delivered him into his hands, and [if] he did not lie in wait for him, then let him be worthy of life and of compensation according to folk-law, if he reaches a place of sanctuary. If, on the other hand, someone kills his neighbour on purpose and willingly by lying in wait, then tear him away from my altar, so that he may die the death.

note.quote: For Alfred, it is the inward disposition of the offender that is crucial ... cf. MP §16; Alfred §5.3 and §44.1 [L 42.1].
